intro.fr: Hololive Treasure Mountain se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Hololive Treasure Mountain can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub StellatedCUBE/Treasure-Mountain-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Hololive Treasure Mountain.
text.en: The GitHub repository StellatedCUBE/Treasure-Mountain-Archipelago, home of the Hololive Treasure Mountain APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.0.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (3 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.0.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (3 versions released).

text.fr: Hololive Treasure Mountain figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Hololive Treasure Mountain is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
